parameters.query: SELECT name, grade, group_name FROM students WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint AND active = true LIMIT 1;

SELECT
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(w), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT idea, max(lesson) AS lesson, count(*)::int AS n FROM mistakes WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint AND coalesce(idea, '') <> '' GROUP BY idea ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5) w) AS weak,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(s), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT homework_code, score, total, created_at FROM submissions WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint AND status = 'graded' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6) s) AS subs,
 (SELECT json_build_object('count', count(*)::int, 'correct', coalesce(sum(score), 0)::int, 'total', coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(answers)), 0)::int) FROM quiz_sessions WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint) AS quiz;
INSERT INTO quiz_sessions (telegram_id, topic, questions, total) VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::int) RETURNING id;

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM quiz_sessions WHERE id = $1::uuid AND telegram_id = $2::bigint LIMIT 1;

WITH u AS (
  UPDATE quiz_sessions SET answers = $2::jsonb, score = $3::int, finished = $4::boolean WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING telegram_id
)
INSERT INTO mistakes (telegram_id, homework_code, question, idea, lesson, correction)
SELECT u.telegram_id, 'QUIZ', m->>'question', m->>'idea', m->>'lesson', m->>'correction'
FROM u, jsonb_array_elements($5::jsonb) AS m
RETURNING id;
